tonight.headline: As set, three of your starters score zero — fix it and you are favoured
body: Bad news first: Terry McLaurin was carted off Monday night with a knee injury Washington fear is season-ending, and the lineup still has Josh Allen and Bhayshul Tuten in it — both on bye — with Jefferson on the bench. As set, AVIATO project 86.5 against JuiceJam's 90.2 and ESPN gives you 47%.

The projection lineup is 129.5: Love for Allen, Gordon for Tuten, Jefferson into the WR slot with Wilson to the flex. JuiceJam are carrying their own bye (James Cook) and Jacobs is day-to-day on their bench. Set the three swaps and place the Metcalf claim before 01:00 tonight.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: You leave Allen and Tuten in the lineup. 42.9 projected points is the gap — more than every margin you have lost by this season.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing about JuiceJam: Cook's bye and Montgomery's OUT are already in their 90.2. Only a Love, Warren or Jefferson injury report this week moves your side.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file 12:50Z · Yahoo 20 Oct · AP 20 Oct

doFirst.title: Claim DK Metcalf
doFirst.subtitle: Drop Terry McLaurin — a feared season-ending knee, and Chem has no IR slot.

case.label: The player
case.body: Pittsburgh's WR1: 15 targets, 11 for 93 in the overtime win over Tampa Bay (Athlon, Yahoo 18 Oct). His quiet Week 5 and the Saturday drop came from an illness that kept him out of Friday practice; he was cleared before kickoff. Michael Pittman (foot, at least two more games) and Roman Wilson (finger, three) are out, so the target tree is narrower (CBS 18 Oct).

case.label: The drop
case.body: McLaurin was carted off in an air cast Monday; Quinn said it 'could be significant' and Rapoport reports the team fears a season-ending injury; the MRI is today (Yahoo, AP 20 Oct). He is 91% rostered — the market has not caught up. Washington are on bye anyway, and Chem has no IR slot, so he holds a dead roster spot.

case.label: The cost
case.body: Priority resets weekly in Chem, so the claim costs nothing lasting. Metcalf does not start this week (14.9 against Wilson's 15.1 is a coin flip the projection gives Wilson); he is the WR depth McLaurin was, for Weeks 8 onward.

case.label: Contested
case.body: A Behind the Steel Curtain headline says Pittsburgh are 'making calls for a wide receiver' and names Metcalf; the page did not load and nothing else confirms it. Taken as noise until a second source.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Washington's MRI shows a short-term injury (back within two weeks) before 01:00 — then cancel the claim. Or Metcalf draws under six targets in two of Weeks 7-9 with Pittman still out (archive).

doFirst.sources: Athlon 18 Oct · Yahoo 18 & 20 Oct · CBS 18 Oct · AP 20 Oct

doFirst.title: Start Jordan Love for Josh Allen
doFirst.subtitle: Buffalo are on bye. Love was added for exactly this week.

case.label: The swap
case.body: Allen projects 0.0 on the bye; Love 19.8 at Detroit, who allow the most quarterback points, in the slate's highest total, 53.5 (Covers 20 Oct).

case.label: Health
case.body: Sacked three times and hit eight against Dallas with no injury reported (Packers.com 19 Oct).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love appears on Green Bay's injury report this week, or another available quarterback projects more than two points higher and is not added.

doFirst.title: Start Ollie Gordon II for Bhayshul Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: Jacksonville are on bye; Gordon is Miami's lead back.

case.label: The swap
case.body: Tuten 0.0 on the bye; Gordon 11.8. Kamara (8.2) is the alternative and sits behind Kendre Miller with a back injury (Athlon 19 Oct).

case.label: The role
case.body: Lead back since Achane's season-ending ACL: 47 carries, 236 yards, 3 TDs (Athlon 17 Oct). Jaylen Wright's foot is unresolved.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Kamara outscores Gordon in Week 7 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Justin Jefferson; bench Tyler Allgeier
doFirst.subtitle: Jefferson is back from the bye; Wilson slides to the flex.

case.label: The swap
case.body: Jefferson 18.6 against Allgeier 7.3 in the flex chain. Allgeier is in a split: Bam Knight out-gained him 80 to 38 (Rotowire 18 Oct), and Jeremiyah Love may return (CBS 19 Oct).

case.label: Who is throwing
case.body: Kyler Murray, Minnesota's starter since Week 3, not yet formally named (CBS/Rotowire log). The tool's 'J.J. McCarthy' is stale — McCarthy is now a Giant.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allgeier outscores Jefferson in Week 7 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 11.0 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara's 14.9 sat behind Allgeier's 5.8 and Love's 20.2 behind Allen's 18.3 — both projection calls, neither an override.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 122.6 to 82.94, a win (archive, 07:05Z). Best possible lineup 133.6. Kamara over Allgeier was 9.1, Love over Allen 1.9.

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost — the 35% the projection gets wrong. The fix is not to override; it is to keep starting by projection and set the lineup every week. This week the lineup as set has two bye players in it.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Week 7 lineup set by projection leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive) — then the lineup rule needs another look.

whatWentWrong.title: McLaurin is gone and holding a roster spot
whatWentWrong.lead: The Week 6 bye cover ended with him carted off; Chem has no IR slot.

case.label: What happened
case.body: He played from the bench Monday, caught one pass, and left in an air cast late in the first quarter (Yahoo 20 Oct). The team fears a season-ending knee injury.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The roster spot is the cost of the Metcalf claim above. Waiting for the diagnosis costs the claim if it lands after 01:00.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The MRI shows a sprain with a two-week timeline — then he keeps the spot and the claim is cancelled.
